ada (Recruiting Ops): Quick heads-up: multiple interview panels from vendor Z's import got the wrong scorecard attached. Senior-engineer panels are showing the 'intern' rubric. Saw it on CAN-701, CAN-705, CAN-712.
jules (People Ops): yikes. How widespread?
ats-import-bot: import job id=job-6677 source=vendor-Z rows=420 warnings=3
ads-import-bot: sample row (sanitized): { candidate_id: "CAN-701", panel_id: "P-2101", score_template: "intern-rubric-v1" }
eric (Eng - Integrations): looks like vendor changed the column from `score_template_id` which we've used to map by canonical slug, to a free-text `score_template` that contains display names. Our importer has a fuzzy match step that picked the closest template and "intern-rubric-v1" was the closest match for several senior templates due to naming overlap.
nora (Interviewer): confirmation: I opened the rubric during debrief and the categories were wrong for senior role. We had to improvise and ended up with inconsistent feedback.
ada (Recruiting Ops): (typo, meant ada) We need to avoid incorrect rubrics; can we revert panels that haven't been completed?
eric (Eng - Integrations): immediate mitigation: 1) disable fuzzy matching and require exact slug mapping for vendor imports. I'll push a hotfix to fail rows with unknown slug instead of guessing. 2) run an audit to find panels created in last 48h where role != rubric.level and flag them.
jules (People Ops): can you also add a human-readable report so hiring mgrs see which panels were affected? They'll need to decide whether to re-interview or salvage feedback.
eric (Eng - Integrations): yes. Plan: hotfix deploy in 20m (hotfix-661), audit job audit-221 queued, and a reattach script to re-map to intended template when mapping is unambiguous. If ambiguous, mark panel "template-mismatch" and notify owner.
ada/ada (Recruiting Ops): thanks. I'll pause any bulk imports from vendor Z until we confirm column schema. Also adding a vendor-checklist item: confirm template slug column and sample values.
nora (Interviewer): small ask: if a panel had the wrong rubric applied but interview already happened, can we copy responses into the correct template partially to preserve notes?
eric (Eng - Integrations): we can attempt a best-effort migrate for open/unfinished panels; for completed panels we'll attach a note and leave original responses intact but flag them in the audit report.
jules (People Ops): vendor outreach: I'll message vendor-Z legal/ops channel and request stable header spec and a sample CSV. Also adding a runbook step to validate `score_template` against ATS template catalog before accepting.
eric (Eng - Integrations): hotfix deployed at 2026-04-14T15:02:05Z. audit-221 started 2026-04-14T15:05:10Z. Preliminary audit found 14 affected panels; 9 were open and auto-reattach succeeded for 7.
ada/ada (Recruiting Ops): will triage remaining panels with hiring owners. Thanks all — reopening if we find more. :white_check_mark:
